description: Represents a record of communication or activity with a contact or partner, often integrated with Gmail. This entity allows for logging and managing various types of engagements.

endpoints.name: CreateInteraction
endpoints.description: Creates a new interaction record, capturing details of a communication or activity. This endpoint is typically used to log interactions originating from Gmail.

model.description: The interaction data to be created.

Date.description: The date and time of the interaction in ISO 8601 format.

Description.description: A detailed description of the interaction.

ContactId.description: The unique identifier of the primary contact involved in the interaction.

EmailAddresses.description: A list of email addresses involved in the interaction.

PhoneNumbers.description: A list of phone numbers involved in the interaction.

ContactIds.description: A list of additional contact IDs involved in the interaction.

PartnerIds.description: A list of partner IDs involved in the interaction.

UserIds.description: A list of user IDs involved in the interaction.

Location.description: The location where the interaction took place.

Subject.description: The subject or title of the interaction.

OrganizationHierarchyIds.description: A list of organization hierarchy IDs related to the interaction.

GmailThreadId.description: The unique identifier of the Gmail thread, if the interaction originated from Gmail.

GmailMessageId.description: The unique identifier of the specific Gmail message, if the interaction originated from Gmail.

Extensions.description: A dictionary for custom key-value pairs to store additional data.

example_uses: Log a new email interaction with a client about project status.
Record a phone call made to a partner regarding a new proposal.
Create an interaction for a meeting held with multiple contacts to discuss quarterly results.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to create a new record of any communication or activity, especially when logging interactions directly from the Gmail addon.

endpoints.name: UpdateInteraction
endpoints.description: Updates an existing interaction record with new or modified details.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the interaction to update.

Date.description: The updated date and time of the interaction.

Description.description: The updated detailed description of the interaction.

ContactId.description: The updated unique identifier of the primary contact involved.

EmailAddresses.description: The updated list of email addresses involved.

PhoneNumbers.description: The updated list of phone numbers involved.

ContactIds.description: The updated list of additional contact IDs involved.

PartnerIds.description: The updated list of partner IDs involved.

UserIds.description: The updated list of user IDs involved.

Location.description: The updated location where the interaction took place.

Subject.description: The updated subject or title of the interaction.

OrganizationHierarchyIds.description: The updated list of organization hierarchy IDs related to the interaction.

Extensions.description: The updated dictionary for custom key-value pairs.

example_uses: Modify the description of an existing interaction to add more details.
Change the type of an interaction from 'Email' to 'Meeting' after a follow-up.
Add more contacts to an already logged interaction that was initially incomplete.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to modify any details of an interaction that has already been created.

endpoints.name: FindGmailInteraction
endpoints.description: Retrieves an interaction record based on its associated Gmail thread ID or message ID. This is useful for checking if an email conversation has already been logged as an interaction.

model.description: The Gmail identifiers to search for an interaction.

GmailThreadId.description: The unique identifier of the Gmail thread to search for.

GmailMessageId.description: The unique identifier of the specific Gmail message to search for.

example_uses: Check if an interaction exists for a specific Gmail thread ID '123xyz'.
Find the interaction linked to a particular email message ID 'abc987'.
Determine if a new interaction needs to be created for a given email by checking its Gmail IDs.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to search for existing interactions that originated from Gmail, using their unique Gmail identifiers.

endpoints.name: FindRelatedRecords
endpoints.description: Finds contacts and partners related to a given set of email addresses or partner IDs. This utility is often used within the Gmail addon to identify existing CRM records associated with email participants.

input.description: The criteria for finding related records.

EmailAddresses.description: A list of email addresses to search for related contacts.

partnerIds.description: A list of partner IDs to search for related partners.

example_uses: Identify CRM contacts associated with email recipients 'john.doe@example.com' and 'jane.smith@example.com'.
Discover partners linked to specific IDs '101', '102' from an email context.
Retrieve existing records for email participants before creating new ones.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to look up existing contacts or partners in the CRM system based on email addresses or partner IDs found in a Gmail context.

endpoints.name: CreateRecordsFromEmails
endpoints.description: Creates new contact or partner records in the CRM system based on selected email addresses and associated partner information from Gmail. This is a utility for quickly onboarding new contacts or partners identified through email.

request.description: The request containing selected contacts to create or update.

SelectedContacts.description: A list of objects, each representing a contact to create or update.

EmailAddress.description: The email address of the contact.

PartnerName.description: The name of the partner associated with the contact (if applicable).

PartnerId.description: The ID of the partner associated with the contact (if applicable).

example_uses: Create new contact records for email senders 'new.contact@domain.com' not yet in the CRM.
Add a new partner record 'Acme Corp' identified from an email signature.
Batch create multiple contacts and link them to existing partners from an email thread.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to create new contact or partner records directly from information extracted from emails, streamlining the data entry process.
